title: Phase-6 Mutation Case
description: Schema for a single mutation case produced by the Phase-6 Mutation Harness. Design-only; used for case generation and validation.

mutation_case_id.description: Unique identifier for the mutation case (e.g. MC-0001).

base_id.description: Reference to the base exemplar from Phase-3 (e.g. BASE-001).

variant_id.description: Optional: specific variant from Phase-4 when mutation targets a variant (e.g. BASE-001-V3). Null when mutation targets base only.

mutation_type.description: Mutation class from Phase-6 Mutation Taxonomy.

mutated_scenario.description: The scenario text after mutation is applied (adversarial input). Must not alter Phase-3/Phase-4 corpus; used as prompt/input to harness.

expected_phase.description: Constitutional phase that the model response must align with (from Phase-3 base mapping).

expected_boundary_anchor.description: Exact boundary phrase (character-for-character from Phase-3) that must be preserved in correct posture. Used for validation.

expected_dominance_rule_triggered.description: One or more dominance rules from Constitutional Manifest that the response must satisfy (e.g. 'REF dominates ambiguity', 'Boundary invariance is mandatory').
